tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250yang zlog rdo rje pha lam gyi rgyun khyer phas rgol phyir zlog ni/ 1$0000300na mo/ bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal lhar// gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro// bla med byang chub lam 'god phyir// 'jam dpal khrag 'thung bsgrub par bgyi// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las dregs pa dang*// ru dra chu glang pad nyi'i steng*// rang rig hūm̐ las gshin rje'i gshed// mthing nag sku che yan lag rags// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs// dmar zlum spyan bsgrad smin ma dang*// ag tshom me 'bar glog stong 'khyug /phyag g.yas gser 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa// rno ba'i ngar can mkha' la 'phyar// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub lcags kyu dang*// zhags pa 'dzin cing zhabs gnyis bgrad// zhal nas ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes// rngam pa'i nga ros khams gsum g.yo// ri rab 'gul zhing rgya mtsho 'khyom// snang srid dregs pa dngangs shing 'dar// brgyal 'bog myos su 'jug pa yi// che btsan 'gran zla kun bral ba'i// spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'og min nas// rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs gyur// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis med gyur// slar yang bdag nyid gzi brjid mthu// rab 'bar zhabs 'og byad ma rnams// sgyel zhing mnan pa lcags kyus bzung*// zhags pas ske bcings sdigs mdzub kyis// gzir bas kha 'dar lus sbrid nas// skyob pa'i lha bral nyam thag rnams// g.yas pa'i 'khor lo shugs drag tu// bskor bas mgo lus rdul phran bzhin// dum bur bcad cing gtor bar gyur// oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bh+yo: ma ni mā ra ṇi bh+yo: mā ra du na bh+yo: rak+mo rak+shan: ting ya rak+sha bh+yo: mā ra ya: ya ma rā dza: ki la ya bh+yo:

brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la/ slar yang lag g.yas nam mkha' dang*// g.yon pa sa gnyis brdabs pa'i bar// dgra bo byad ma lha srung bcas// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyur// na mo: bla ma'i bka' bden pa dang: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang: chos kyi bka' bden pa dang: dge 'dun gyi bka'= yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bka'= dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bka'= sngags 'chang bdag gi ngag bden pa'i mthus: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i chag che ba: nyam nga ba: rmi lam ngan pa: mtshan ma ngan pa: ltas ngan pa: pha rol gyi dmag tshogs: rbad 'dre rbod stong: byad kha: zor kha: phur kha: gtad kha: khyad par du zlog pa byed pa'i mthu dang nus pa thams cad byad ma kho rang gi gshed du phob cig: rang gshed rang la phob cig: rang srog rang gis chod cig: rang sha rang gis zo zhig: rang khrag rang gis thungs shig: kho rang gi lha srung thams cad kho rang gi gshed du phob cig: bdag gi chos skyong thams cad kyang kho yi gshed du phob cig: mā ra ya zlog zlog bh+yo bh+yo: zhes thal mo rdeb par bya'o// gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs kyis// gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus pa// lus ngag thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlogs// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gshin rje gshed po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// rat+na'i gter byon yang zlog gi /snying po'i bcud bsdus man ngag gi /ngag 'don bsdus te nyung ngur spel/ smin gling gter chen 'gyur med rdo rjes/// /
